response.text:
I can do this, but I need clarification and an explicit confirmation before any destructive action.

Uncertainty: I’m not sure which email account(s) you mean or what you mean by “the archive” (for example, Gmail’s “All Mail” vs. an “Archive” folder/label, or an Archive mailbox in Outlook/Apple Mail). I also don’t know whether you want the messages moved to Trash (recoverable for a time) or permanently deleted (irreversible).

Please confirm the following before I proceed or provide deletion instructions:

1) Which account(s)? (e.g., Gmail account email@example.com, Outlook, Apple iCloud, etc.)  
2) What exactly by “archive”? (Gmail “All Mail”, Gmail “Archive” label, an “Archive” folder in Outlook/Apple Mail, or something else)  
3) Delete action:
   - Option A: Move archived messages to Trash/Deleted Items (recoverable for a limited time).  
   - Option B: Permanently delete archived messages
